The chapter heading IN THE MOSLEM QUARTER is followed by the opening set in small capitals, TO AWAKEN QUITE ALONE IN A STRANGE TOWN IS ONE OF, running on into the pleasantest sensations in the world, and the paragraph continues You are surrounded by adventure. You have no idea of what is in store for you, but you will, if you are wise and know the art of travel, let yourself go on the stream of the unknown and accept whatever comes in the spirit in which the gods may offer it. word for word, before For this reason your customary thoughts. Small capitals are the printer’s opening flourish, not a different reading, so setting the first clause in ordinary type is faithful.
